notes:
Rameez: take instagram.com/reel/DbVnOOksf-c (alumaetg, aluminium linear-profile maker, 28.5s) and change the linear's material to TEAK, keeping the rest as it was. Their cut points were measured off the source at 10 fps: 8.1 / 0.4 / 3.1 / 1.5 / 11.9 / 0.6 / 2.9 s. THIS BRIEF MATCHES THAT STRUCTURE AND THOSE DURATIONS, with `cut: 1.0` so `beats` are literal seconds. Their 8.1s single assembly take is rebuilt as 2.5 + 2.2 + 1.7 + 1.7 of wipes, so the assembly happens inside the take exactly as theirs does. Their 11.9s ceiling-install take becomes canopy 4.5 + dark lines 3.7 + real workshop footage 3.7 (the craftsman, which is where 'we make it ourselves' lands). NONE OF THEIR FOOTAGE IS USED — only their shot list and timings, which are not theirs to own. Every frame is NixWoods: four teak stages (recoloured from our own generated rosewood renders, target sampled from our own teak photography) and six real teak product photographs already in teak-reels/hf/. Zero generation cost. The source-overrun guard caught a first attempt that asked 3.9s of a 3.1s clip — it would have silently truncated everything after it, exactly the fault that cost the shelf reel its end card. Hook: 'everyone makes these in aluminium.' scored 4/12 (no gap, no pull) — it states the category instead of withholding something. 'this one is not aluminium.' scores 8/12: the gap is what it IS, and the assembly answers it. Source resolution checked against the frame before shipping: t_endcap is 493px and t_strip 595px, 2.2x and 1.8x upscaled under `contain` and visibly soft. Both replaced with t_underside (1254px) and t_dark (1170px), which need 1.5x and 1.6x. Structure and durations unchanged — only the source behind three short shots.

L2b (this variant): ONE change from L2 — the workshop 'polish' shot's post filter. L2 asked eq=brightness=-0.12:contrast=1.06 on top of the noir grade, which already carries brightness=-0.04, contrast=1.16 and a curve pulling 0.3 to 0.29. Stacked on handheld footage of dark-stained boards (raw frame mean luma 121, p10 38) the beat rendered as an illegible blue-black smear on the contact sheet. It is the LONGEST single beat at 3.7s and it carries the payoff line 'we make it ourselves', so illegible is expensive. Changed to eq=brightness=0.07:contrast=1.03:saturation=1.06, which lifts it back to readable while the global noir grade still holds the reel together. Nothing else differs: same shots, same durations, same text, same audio.
name: L2b-linear-teak
